fundamentals.pe_assessment: Trailing P/E is 45.0x and forward P/E is 36.461403x. The forward discount is consistent with expected earnings growth, but the absolute multiple leaves limited margin of safety if semiconductor demand or margins disappoint.
fundamentals.margin_analysis: Revenue is RM607,759,744, net income is RM154,227,874, and reported gross, operating, and net margins are 49.6%, 36.9%, and 25.4%. These are strong profitability metrics for the supplied financial snapshot; the 5 Aug 2026 Q2 filing also reported 1H revenue of RM376.719m versus RM288.991m a year earlier and attributable profit of RM90.077m versus RM64.556m.
fundamentals.debt_analysis: Total debt is RM28,905,484 against RM1,036,080,401 of equity, approximately 2.8% debt-to-equity. The balance sheet therefore appears lightly levered, with relatively low financial-risk sensitivity in this snapshot.
fundamentals.growth_outlook: The latest available Q2 2026 filing reported quarterly revenue growth of about 19.5% year over year and 1H revenue growth of about 30.4%; attributable profit grew about 42.5% in the quarter and 39.6% year to date. Search evidence also points to improving semiconductor orders and AI-related demand, but the cycle remains a key dependency.
key_risks: 45.0x trailing P/E and 36.461403x forward P/E embed substantial growth expectations.
Semiconductor and advanced-equipment demand can be cyclical; reported market commentary also notes weaker oil-and-gas activity as an offset.
The supplied financial snapshot does not include customer concentration, geographic revenue mix, or forward guidance detail.
key_strengths: Strong supplied margins: 49.6% gross, 36.9% operating, and 25.4% net.
Free cash flow of RM160,174,898 is slightly above supplied net income of RM154,227,874.
Very low debt relative to equity and positive earnings/cash generation.
Latest Q2/1H filing showed accelerating revenue and attributable-profit growth.
fundamentals.summary: FRONTKN combines strong reported profitability—RM607.76m revenue, RM154.23m net income, RM160.17m free cash flow, and 49.6%/36.9%/25.4% gross/operating/net margins—with very light leverage of approximately 2.8% debt to equity. The 45.0x trailing P/E and 36.461403x forward P/E price in a meaningful growth runway, although the latest Q2 filing’s strong 1H growth provides evidence behind that premium. The fundamental signal is buy at medium confidence, constrained by valuation and semiconductor-cycle sensitivity.
